goal: Separate block material candidate: real texture detail plus normal and dielectric roughness response on sand, stone and oak planks. Aurora water is inherited unchanged.
referenceSummary: Owner's two references show warm low sunlight, darker shaded block faces, trees and buildings casting shadows, peach haze and clouds, and landscape shapes reflected in water. These are appearance observations; this original candidate has no claim of matching them in game yet.
pipeline: Early full-screen linear sky background into colortex0; shadow pass writes alpha-tested depth with an unwarped projection.
Forward geometry writes lit linear HDR to colortex0, with separate direct, ambient and block light.
Deferred copies opaque colortex0 into colortex4 before translucent rendering.
Water/glass write colortex1 cleared to transparent; water traces depthtex1 and reads the opaque colortex4 snapshot.
Composite combines the scene and translucent layer with contact occlusion, depth haze and screen-space shafts.
Final samples highlights for bloom, applies exposure and tone mapping once, then converts to display gamma.

features.name: Directional lighting on ordinary blocks
features.technique: World-oriented normals and active sun/moon direction, warm direct light, separate ambient skylight and warm block-light channels, biome tint and vertex AO.
features.limitations: Source implementation only; day/night, entities and material appearance need Iris tests. No global illumination or PBR surface relief.

features.name: Soft filtered cast shadows
features.technique: 2048px unwarped 96-block shadow depth map with cutout alpha, normal offset, slope bias, nine depth comparisons and distance fade; shadows attenuate direct light only.
features.limitations: Finite coverage and fixed PCF softness. Bias/cutout quality needs runtime checking; translucent coloured shadows are omitted.

features.name: Recognisable landscape water reflections
features.technique: Deferred opaque-scene copy into colortex4, then 48 quadratically spaced view-space ray steps up to roughly 144 blocks using depthtex1, binary refinement, edge fading and a matching procedural sky fallback.
features.limitations: Only scenery visible in the screen buffers is available. No working reflected-object visibility or reference fidelity is claimed before Iris tests.

features.name: Calm water and transparent shallows
features.technique: Animated world-anchored normals, Fresnel reflectivity, depth-based absorption and screen-space refraction, with material IDs separating water from glass.
features.limitations: One unblended nearest translucent layer does not accumulate overlapping glass/water. No foam, caustics or displaced waves. Underwater needs testing.

features.name: Golden sky and soft clouds
features.technique: Sun-elevation-dependent horizon/zenith colours, solar and lunar discs and a world-oriented animated soft noise cloud plane, shared with reflection fallback.
features.limitations: Soft 2D cloud layer, not volumetric clouds. Initial Overworld target only; lower sky and night need visual evaluation.

features.name: Atmospheric depth and contact shading
features.technique: Depth-reconstructed distance haze matching the sky, eight-sample contact occlusion and twelve-sample depth-occluded screen-space sunlight shafts.
features.limitations: No true volumetric scattering or indirect illumination. Occlusion and shafts may have screen-space artefacts.

features.name: Controlled highlight glow
features.technique: Two-radius highlight-only sampling in linear HDR, followed by one exposure/filmic/display transform.
features.limitations: Small fixed sampling kernel, not a multi-resolution bloom pyramid; quality and performance require runtime evaluation.

features.name: Terrain material highlights and inferred relief
features.technique: Terrain IDs select roughness/metal response. Shadow-gated GGX-style highlights and small, bounded colour-height surface gradients add near-camera detail while shadow bias uses geometric normals.
features.limitations: Other material categories retain small colour-height approximations; the three mapped fixtures instead use companion normal/smoothness data. No geometric displacement. Close-up shimmer and material appearance need game tests.

features.name: Three companion block materials
features.technique: Companion 512px albedo/_n/_s resource textures; matched tangent basis, reconstructed normal Z and dielectric smoothness/F0 decoding, material-ID gated before cutout discard.
features.limitations: Needs BlocksLab-materials-01 resource pack. Three dielectric fixtures only, not full LabPBR compliance. No POM, geometric displacement or visual acceptance. All prior Aurora test evidence is historical.
